name: Ecommerce Sales Monitor
prompt: Build an e-commerce sales monitor. Put a global date range picker at the very top. I need KPI metrics for Gross Sales, Net Conversions, and Cart Abandonment. Include an area chart showing daily gross sales vs net sales, and a small pie chart showing traffic sources.

thought_process.interpretation: The user wants a functional e-commerce sales monitor dashboard. As an Expert React Developer, I will build an interactive application that includes a date range filter, KPI metrics for Gross Sales, Net Conversions, and Cart Abandonment, an area chart comparing Gross vs. Net Sales over time, and a pie chart for traffic source distribution. I will include a detailed transaction log to satisfy the requirement for large datasets.
assumed_from_scratch: Date filtering logic for mock datasets
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Consider adding a 'Product Performance' heat map and 'Customer Retention' cohorts for deeper analysis of the ecomm.order_items table.
